summary: The live dashboard served by Cloud Run said that no measured facts were supplied, so every light showed no data and every duration was empty, because the web_data job built the views with no facts. It now runs collect_facts first (the project is public, so no token) and passes build/facts.json to build_state. If the API does not answer, the job fails and nothing is deployed with a dashboard that looks complete and is not. 1 test failed on the old code.
